name: Tree of Thoughts
titleZh: 思维树：用大模型做审慎的问题求解
summary: Generalises chain-of-thought into search over several reasoning paths, with self-evaluation and backtracking.
summaryZh: 把思维链推广成对多条推理路径的搜索，允许自评与回溯。
keyFact: Tree of Thoughts (Yao et al., arXiv:2305.10601, 2023-05-17) let a model explore and backtrack across multiple reasoning paths; on Game of 24 it lifted GPT-4 from 4% with chain-of-thought prompting to 74% success.
keyFactZh: 思维树（Yao 等，arXiv:2305.10601，2023-05-17）让模型在多条推理路径上探索并回溯；在 Game of 24 任务上把 GPT-4 的成绩从思维链提示的 4% 提升到 74%。
whyItMatters: The clearest evidence that inference-time search, not just a bigger model, buys reasoning gains.
whyItMattersZh: 它最清楚地证明了：推理能力不只靠更大的模型，推理时的搜索同样能换来提升。
title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
